About.welcome_title: Welcome to the Ottawa Centre for Cognitive Therapy (OCCT).
About.welcome_text: At OCCT, we're dedicated to providing you with the most effective and efficient therapy experience. To ensure the best possible match, we'll carefully review your needs and connect you with one of our highly experienced psychologists who specializes in your area of concern.
About.doctor_bio: Dr. Jane Blouin. I began my career as a psychologist conducting research at the National Institute of Mental Health in Bethesda, Maryland. Upon my return to Canada over 35 years ago, I joined the Department of Psychiatry at the University of Ottawa, where I developed innovative clinical programs while conducting research and teaching. For the past 30 years, I have served as the Director of the Centre for Cognitive Therapy, dedicating my time to advancing cognitive therapy and being an active cognitive therapist.
About.quick_guide_text: Quick Guide; Next, we will begin with questions about your background. In the top right corner of your screen, you’ll notice a small speaker icon — that’s where you can turn Dr. Blouin’s voice on or off, depending on what feels most comfortable for you. Next to it, there’s a little switch that lets you choose whether the audio plays automatically for each question. You will also see an Exit and Save message. This allows you to take breaks during the interviews, and the system will save your responses so that you can return and pick up right where you left off. Take your time — you’re in control!
